column2:
radar(n.)雷達
(無詞性變化)
radar screen 雷達螢幕
under the radar 不受注意地
The plane disappeared from the radar screen over the ocean.
(那架飛機在海洋上空從雷達螢幕上消失了。)
The small company grew quickly while staying under the radar.
(那間小公司在不受注意的情況下迅速成長。)

rage(n./v.)狂怒、盛怒、肆虐
(無詞性變化)
in a rage 盛怒之下
road rage 路怒症
He broke the cup in a fit of rage.
(他在盛怒之下打破了杯子。)
The fire raged through the forest for three days.
(大火在森林中肆虐了三天。)

rainfall(n.)降雨量、降雨
(無詞性變化)
heavy rainfall 大量降雨
annual rainfall 年降雨量
Heavy rainfall caused landslides in the mountain areas.
(大量降雨造成山區土石流。)
Taiwan has a high annual rainfall compared with many countries.
(和許多國家相比，台灣的年降雨量很高。)

raisin(n.)葡萄乾
(無詞性變化)
raisin bread 葡萄乾麵包
a handful of raisins 一把葡萄乾
My mother adds raisins to the cookies she bakes.
(我媽媽在她烤的餅乾裡加了葡萄乾。)
Raisin bread is one of my favorite breakfasts.
(葡萄乾麵包是我最喜歡的早餐之一。)

realistic(adj.)實際的、務實的、逼真的
realism(n.)現實主義、寫實
realistically(adv.)實際地
realistic goal 實際的目標
realistic picture 寫實的描繪
It's important to set realistic goals for your studies.
(為課業設定實際可行的目標很重要。)
The special effects in the movie look very realistic.
(這部電影的特效看起來非常逼真。)

rebel(n./v.)叛亂者、反抗者、反叛
rebellion(n.)叛亂、反抗
rebellious(adj.)叛逆的
rebel against 反抗
rebel army 叛軍
Many teenagers rebel against their parents' rules.
(許多青少年反抗父母的規定。)
The rebels took control of the capital city.
(叛軍控制了首都。)

recall(v./n.)回想起、召回
(無詞性變化)
recall a name 想起名字
product recall 產品召回
I can't recall where I put my keys.
(我想不起來把鑰匙放在哪裡。)
The company announced a recall of the faulty cars.
(那家公司宣布召回有瑕疵的汽車。)

reception(n.)接待處、歡迎會、接收(訊號)
receptionist(n.)接待員
receive(v.)收到、接待
wedding reception 婚宴
reception desk 接待櫃台
Please leave your key at the reception desk.
(請把鑰匙留在接待櫃台。)
The phone reception is poor in this building.
(這棟大樓裡的手機收訊很差。)

recipe(n.)食譜、祕訣
(無詞性變化)
follow a recipe 照著食譜做
recipe for success 成功的祕訣
I followed my grandmother's recipe to make beef noodles.
(我照著奶奶的食譜做牛肉麵。)
Hard work is the recipe for success.
(努力是成功的祕訣。)

recognition(n.)認出、承認、表揚
recognize(v.)認出、承認
face recognition 臉部辨識
in recognition of 為表揚……
My phone uses face recognition to unlock.
(我的手機用臉部辨識解鎖。)
She received an award in recognition of her volunteer work.
(她獲頒獎項以表揚她的志工服務。)

recovery(n.)恢復、康復、復甦
recover(v.)恢復、康復
make a full recovery 完全康復
economic recovery 經濟復甦
The player made a full recovery after the knee surgery.
(那位選手膝蓋手術後完全康復。)
The government hopes for a quick economic recovery.
(政府希望經濟能迅速復甦。)

recreation(n.)娛樂、消遣
recreational(adj.)娛樂的、休閒的
recreation center 休閒中心
outdoor recreation 戶外休閒活動
The park offers many kinds of outdoor recreation.
(這座公園提供多種戶外休閒活動。)
Reading is my favorite form of recreation.
(閱讀是我最喜歡的消遣。)

recycle(v.)回收、再利用
recycling(n.)回收
recyclable(adj.)可回收的
recycle plastic 回收塑膠
recycling bin 回收桶
We should recycle plastic bottles to protect the environment.
(我們應該回收塑膠瓶來保護環境。)
Taiwan is well known for its high recycling rate.
(台灣以高回收率聞名。)

reduction(n.)減少、降低、折扣
reduce(v.)減少、降低
price reduction 降價
reduction in ……的減少
The store is offering a big price reduction this week.
(這家店本週大降價。)
There has been a reduction in traffic accidents this year.
(今年交通事故減少了。)

refer(v.)提到、參考、轉介
reference(n.)參考、提及
referee(n.)裁判
refer to 提到、參考、指的是
refer A to B 將A轉介給B
The word 'it' here refers to the old house.
(這裡的「it」指的是那棟老房子。)
You may refer to your notes during the test.
(考試時你可以參考筆記。)

reference(n.)參考、參考資料、提及、推薦信
refer(v.)提到、參考
reference book 參考書
with reference to 關於
I borrowed some reference books from the library.
(我從圖書館借了一些參考書。)
My teacher wrote a letter of reference for my college application.
(我的老師為我的大學申請寫了一封推薦信。)

reflect(v.)反射、反映、反思
reflection(n.)反射、倒影、反思
reflective(adj.)反射的、沉思的
reflect on 反思
reflect light 反射光線
The calm lake reflected the mountains like a mirror.
(平靜的湖面像鏡子一樣映出群山。)
Take some time to reflect on what you have learned.
(花些時間反思你學到了什麼。)

reflection(n.)倒影、反射、反思
reflect(v.)反射、反映、反思
reflection in the mirror 鏡中的倒影
on reflection 經過仔細考慮
The cat stared at its reflection in the mirror.
(那隻貓盯著鏡中自己的倒影。)
On reflection, I think I made the wrong choice.
(仔細想想，我覺得自己做錯了選擇。)

reform(n./v.)改革、改進
reformer(n.)改革者
education reform 教育改革
political reform 政治改革
The new education reform has changed how students learn.
(新的教育改革改變了學生學習的方式。)
The government promised to reform the tax system.
(政府承諾改革稅制。)

refugee(n.)難民
refuge(n.)避難、避難所
refugee camp 難民營
war refugee 戰爭難民
Thousands of refugees fled the war to neighboring countries.
(數千名難民逃離戰爭到鄰近國家。)
Volunteers delivered food to the refugee camp.
(志工把食物送到難民營。)

refund(n./v.)退款、退還
refundable(adj.)可退款的
full refund 全額退款
ask for a refund 要求退款
If you are not satisfied, you can get a full refund.
(如果你不滿意，可以獲得全額退款。)
The airline refunded our tickets because of the typhoon.
(航空公司因颱風退還了我們的機票錢。)

refusal(n.)拒絕
refuse(v.)拒絕
flat refusal 斷然拒絕
refusal to 拒絕做……
His refusal to help surprised everyone.
(他拒絕幫忙讓大家很驚訝。)
She answered with a flat refusal.
(她斷然拒絕了。)

regarding(prep.)關於、有關
regard(v./n.)認為、尊重
regardless(adv.)不管、無論
regarding the matter 關於此事
questions regarding 有關……的問題
If you have any questions regarding the trip, please ask me.
(如果你對這趟旅程有任何問題，請問我。)
The school sent a notice regarding the new dress code.
(學校發出了一份關於新服裝規定的通知。)

register(v./n.)登記、註冊、名冊
registration(n.)登記、註冊
registered(adj.)已註冊的、掛號的
register for 報名
registered mail 掛號信
You need to register for the course before Friday.
(你需要在星期五之前報名這門課。)
I sent the important documents by registered mail.
(我用掛號信寄出重要文件。)

registration(n.)登記、註冊、報名
register(v./n.)登記、註冊
registration fee 報名費
online registration 線上報名
Online registration for the marathon starts next Monday.
(馬拉松線上報名下週一開始。)
The registration fee includes a T-shirt and a medal.
(報名費包含一件T恤和一面獎牌。)

regulate(v.)管理、調節、控制
regulation(n.)規定、管制
regulator(n.)管理者、調節器
regulate temperature 調節溫度
strictly regulate 嚴格管制
Sweating helps the body regulate its temperature.
(流汗幫助身體調節體溫。)
The government strictly regulates the sale of medicine.
(政府嚴格管制藥品的販售。)

regulation(n.)規定、法規、管制
regulate(v.)管理、調節
safety regulations 安全規定
follow regulations 遵守規定
All workers must follow the safety regulations.
(所有工人都必須遵守安全規定。)
New regulations on plastic bags will take effect next year.
(關於塑膠袋的新規定明年起生效。)

rejection(n.)拒絕、駁回
reject(v.)拒絕、駁回
fear of rejection 害怕被拒絕
rejection letter 拒絕信
He was afraid of rejection, so he never asked her out.
(他害怕被拒絕，所以從未約她出去。)
She received a rejection letter from the university.
(她收到那所大學的拒絕信。)

relaxation(n.)放鬆、休閒
relax(v.)放鬆
relaxed(adj.)放鬆的
relaxation techniques 放鬆技巧
for relaxation 為了放鬆
I listen to music for relaxation after school.
(放學後我聽音樂來放鬆。)
Deep breathing is one of the easiest relaxation techniques.
(深呼吸是最簡單的放鬆技巧之一。)

relevant(adj.)相關的、切題的
relevance(n.)關聯、相關性
irrelevant(adj.)無關的
relevant information 相關資訊
be relevant to 與……有關
Please include only relevant information in your report.
(你的報告裡請只放相關的資訊。)
His question is not relevant to today's topic.
(他的問題與今天的主題無關。)

relieve(v.)減輕、緩和、使放心
relief(n.)放心、緩解
relieved(adj.)放心的
relieve stress 紓解壓力
relieve pain 減輕疼痛
Exercise is a good way to relieve stress.
(運動是紓解壓力的好方法。)
I was relieved to hear that you passed the exam.
(聽到你通過考試，我鬆了一口氣。)

reluctant(adj.)不情願的、勉強的
reluctance(n.)不情願
reluctantly(adv.)不情願地
be reluctant to 不情願做……
reluctant agreement 勉強同意
He was reluctant to tell his parents about the bad grade.
(他不願意把成績不好的事告訴父母。)
She reluctantly agreed to lend me her notes.
(她勉強答應借我她的筆記。)

remark(n./v.)評論、言論、談到
remarkable(adj.)非凡的、值得注意的
make a remark 發表評論
rude remark 無禮的言論
He made a rude remark about her new hairstyle.
(他對她的新髮型說了很無禮的話。)
Many visitors remarked on how clean the city was.
(許多遊客都談到這座城市有多乾淨。)

remarkable(adj.)非凡的、值得注意的、卓越的
remarkably(adv.)非常地、顯著地
remark(n./v.)評論、談到
remarkable achievement 卓越的成就
remarkable progress 顯著的進步
Winning three gold medals is a remarkable achievement.
(贏得三面金牌是一項卓越的成就。)
He has made remarkable progress in math this semester.
(他這學期數學有顯著的進步。)

remedy(n./v.)治療法、補救辦法、補救
(無詞性變化)
home remedy 偏方、居家療法
remedy the situation 補救情況
Hot ginger tea is a popular home remedy for colds.
(熱薑茶是治療感冒的常見偏方。)
The school took steps to remedy the problem.
(學校採取措施來補救這個問題。)

renew(v.)更新、續借、使恢復
renewal(n.)更新、續約
renewable(adj.)可再生的
renew a passport 換發護照
renew a contract 續約
I need to renew my library books before Friday.
(我需要在星期五前續借圖書館的書。)
Solar power is a kind of renewable energy.
(太陽能是一種再生能源。)

repetition(n.)重複、反覆
repeat(v.)重複
repetitive(adj.)重複的、單調的
through repetition 透過反覆練習
avoid repetition 避免重複
Learning new words takes a lot of repetition.
(學習新單字需要大量的反覆練習。)
Try to avoid repetition of the same words in your essay.
(你的作文裡試著避免重複使用相同的字。)

representation(n.)代表、表現、描繪
represent(v.)代表、象徵
representative(n./adj.)代表、具代表性的
accurate representation 準確的描繪
political representation 政治代表權
The painting is a representation of life in old Taipei.
(這幅畫描繪了舊時台北的生活。)
Women want more representation in government.
(女性希望在政府中有更多代表。)

reputation(n.)名聲、聲譽
reputable(adj.)聲譽好的
good reputation 好名聲
have a reputation for 以……聞名
The restaurant has a good reputation for its fresh seafood.
(這家餐廳以新鮮海鮮享有好名聲。)
One mistake can damage a company's reputation.
(一個錯誤就可能損害公司的聲譽。)

rescue(n./v.)救援、營救
rescuer(n.)救援者
rescue team 救援隊
come to the rescue 前來救援
The rescue team searched for the missing climbers all night.
(救難隊整晚搜尋失蹤的登山客。)
Firefighters rescued a cat from the burning house.
(消防員從失火的房子裡救出一隻貓。)

research(n./v.)研究、調查
researcher(n.)研究人員
do research on 研究……
research project 研究計畫
Scientists are doing research on new kinds of energy.
(科學家正在研究新型態的能源。)
We researched the history of our town for the project.
(我們為了專題研究了我們城鎮的歷史。)

researcher(n.)研究人員
research(n./v.)研究
medical researcher 醫學研究人員
team of researchers 研究團隊
A team of researchers discovered a new kind of frog.
(一個研究團隊發現了一種新的青蛙。)
My aunt works as a medical researcher at a hospital.
(我阿姨在一家醫院擔任醫學研究人員。)

resemble(v.)像、與……相似
resemblance(n.)相似
closely resemble 非常相似
resemble each other 彼此相似
The little girl closely resembles her mother.
(那個小女孩長得非常像她的媽媽。)
The rock resembles an elephant's head.
(那塊岩石像大象的頭。)

reservation(n.)預訂、保留、疑慮
reserve(v./n.)預訂、保留
make a reservation 預訂
without reservation 毫無保留地
I made a reservation for dinner at seven.
(我預訂了七點的晚餐。)
She supported the plan without reservation.
(她毫無保留地支持這項計畫。)

resign(v.)辭職、放棄
resignation(n.)辭職、辭呈
resigned(adj.)聽天由命的、順從的
resign from 辭去
resign oneself to 只好接受
The manager resigned from his job last month.
(那位經理上個月辭職了。)
He resigned himself to staying home during the typhoon.
(颱風期間他只好接受待在家裡。)

resignation(n.)辭職、辭呈、聽天由命
resign(v.)辭職
hand in one's resignation 遞辭呈
letter of resignation 辭職信
She handed in her resignation to the boss this morning.
(她今天早上向老闆遞出辭呈。)
He accepted the bad news with quiet resignation.
(他默默地接受了這個壞消息。)

resistance(n.)抵抗、反抗、抵抗力
resist(v.)抵抗
resistant(adj.)有抵抗力的
resistance to 對……的抵抗
meet with resistance 遭到反對
The new rule met with strong resistance from students.
(新規定遭到學生強烈的反對。)
Regular exercise can improve your resistance to illness.
(規律運動能提升你對疾病的抵抗力。)

resolution(n.)決心、決議、解決、解析度
resolve(v./n.)解決、決心
New Year's resolution 新年新希望
high resolution 高解析度
My New Year's resolution is to exercise every day.
(我的新年新希望是每天運動。)
This camera takes high resolution photos.
(這台相機能拍出高解析度的照片。)

resolve(v./n.)解決、決心、決定
resolution(n.)決心、解決
resolve a problem 解決問題
resolve a conflict 化解衝突
The two sides met to resolve the conflict.
(雙方會面以化解衝突。)
She resolved to study harder after the failure.
(失敗後她下定決心更用功讀書。)

respectable(adj.)值得尊敬的、體面的、可觀的
respect(n./v.)尊敬
respectable job 體面的工作
respectable score 可觀的分數
His parents want him to find a respectable job.
(他父母希望他找份體面的工作。)
Our team finished the race with a respectable time.
(我們的隊伍以不錯的成績完成比賽。)

respectful(adj.)尊敬的、有禮貌的
respect(n./v.)尊敬
respectfully(adv.)尊敬地
be respectful to 對……有禮貌
respectful silence 肅靜以表敬意
Students should be respectful to their teachers.
(學生應該尊敬老師。)
The crowd stood in respectful silence for one minute.
(群眾肅立默哀一分鐘。)

restore(v.)恢復、修復、歸還
restoration(n.)恢復、修復
restore order 恢復秩序
restore power 恢復供電
Workers restored the old temple to its original beauty.
(工人將老廟宇修復成原本的美麗樣貌。)
Power was restored a few hours after the typhoon.
(颱風過後幾小時就恢復供電了。)

restriction(n.)限制、約束
restrict(v.)限制
restrictive(adj.)限制性的
age restriction 年齡限制
impose restrictions on 對……加以限制
There is an age restriction for this movie.
(這部電影有年齡限制。)
The city imposed restrictions on water use during the drought.
(乾旱期間市政府對用水加以限制。)

retain(v.)保持、保留、記住
retention(n.)保留、記憶力
retain heat 保溫
retain information 記住資訊
This bottle can retain heat for twelve hours.
(這個瓶子可以保溫十二小時。)
Taking notes helps you retain information better.
(做筆記幫助你更好地記住資訊。)

retire(v.)退休、retirement(n.)退休
retired(adj.)退休的
retire from 從……退休
early retirement 提早退休
My grandfather retired from teaching at the age of 65.
(我爺爺六十五歲時從教職退休。)
She plans to travel around the world after her retirement.
(她打算退休後環遊世界。)

retreat(n./v.)撤退、退縮、靜修處
(無詞性變化)
beat a retreat 匆忙撤退
mountain retreat 山中隱居處
The army was forced to retreat after the battle.
(戰役後軍隊被迫撤退。)
They spent the weekend at a quiet mountain retreat.
(他們在寧靜的山中小屋度過週末。)

reunion(n.)團聚、重聚、同學會
reunite(v.)重聚、再結合
family reunion 家庭團聚
class reunion 同學會
Lunar New Year is a time for family reunion.
(農曆新年是家人團聚的時刻。)
We had a class reunion ten years after graduation.
(我們在畢業十年後舉辦了同學會。)

revenge(n./v.)報仇、復仇
(無詞性變化)
take revenge on 向……報仇
get revenge 報仇
The movie is about a man who takes revenge on his enemies.
(這部電影講述一名男子向仇人報仇的故事。)
Our team got revenge by winning this year's final.
(我們隊贏得今年的決賽，報了一箭之仇。)

revise(v.)修改、修訂、複習
revision(n.)修訂、複習
revise an essay 修改作文
revised edition 修訂版
Please revise your essay and hand it in again.
(請修改你的作文再交一次。)
The revised edition of the dictionary includes many new words.
(這本字典的修訂版收錄了許多新字。)

revision(n.)修訂、修改、複習
revise(v.)修改、修訂
make revisions 做修改
revision of ……的修訂
The writer made several revisions before finishing the book.
(作者在完成這本書之前做了好幾次修改。)
The revision of the law took two years.
